crossRefs.note: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they…
that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

translations.web: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
translations.bsb: Teach them to your children, speaking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
translations.kjv: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
translations.asv: And ye shall teach them your children, talking of them, when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
